probe_notes: No score changes this week — the leaderboard is stable at its week-3 state. Zoo MCP hit v0.16.5 on Jun 12 and the modeling API refreshed Jun 13, confirming the most actively maintained agent surface in the probe. Fusion AI shipped MCP auto-config robustness improvements and a multi-level help system — lowering first-call friction but not unlocking new gates. MecAgent published a blog post ('How MCP Opens the Door and Why Specialized APIs Must Take It Further') explicitly framing their architectural choice as proprietary macro execution via SolidWorks/Inventor APIs rather than generic MCP — a deliberate non-MCP stance, not a gap. Adam continues to expand substrates quietly (Onshape, Fusion, SolidWorks confirmed) with no public API surface added.

parametric_edit.notes: Add/Delete Feature endpoints confirmed in API docs. KCL (KittyCAD Language) is a purpose-built parametric scripting language that an agent can write to edit assemblies end-to-end. Multi-file CAD iteration endpoint (/ml/text-to-cad/multi-file/iteration) confirmed. zoo_execute_kcl tool in MCP server confirmed this run.

feature_tree_introspection.notes: Mass, volume, surface-area, density, bounding-box, and center-of-mass endpoints documented. Zoo MCP supports inspecting design files and parametric KCL code. Full model-state read access confirmed.

structured_output.notes: REST APIs use JSON request/response bodies with OpenAPI spec at root endpoint for schema-driven client generation. KCL completions endpoint schema-driven. MCP tool calls follow JSON-RPC with typed schemas.

mcp_compat.notes: Public MCP server (zoo-mcp) — v0.16.5 released Jun 12, 2026 (51 total releases, 161 commits on main). 'Bridge between an AI client and Zoo's design tools.' Setup: `uvx zoo-mcp` with ZOO_API_TOKEN. Supports Claude, Codex CLI, MCP Inspector. Prebuilt binaries for Linux/macOS/Windows — no Python install required. Text-to-CAD MCP tool confirmed. DXF export added as output format.

headless_mode.notes: TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go SDKs plus CLI (`zoo kcl`, `zoo file`, `zoo ml` subcommands) plus direct HTTP. Modeling API updated Jun 13, 2026. API-first design = pure headless with no display dependency.

auth_accessibility.notes: Bearer-token auth via API tokens (self-serve). OAuth2 device authorization grant and provider-based consent flows documented. Service account support for org-level automation.

diff_friendly_export.notes: KCL is a parametric scripting language stored as text — line-level git-diffable. `zoo kcl format` and `zoo kcl lint` promote consistency. DXF export added this cycle (vector format — not parametric-script but better than STL). Code-as-CAD by design; KCL remains the canonical diff surface.

dfm_feedback.notes: GD&T/MBD annotation support confirmed (flatness, datum annotations in Design Studio). No wall-thickness, process-level DfM, or manufacturing constraint endpoints in API docs. GD&T is tolerancing specification, not process-level manufacturability feedback. Score holds at 5; the last 10 points require structured DfM endpoints — not yet shipped.

structured_output.notes: LLM-driven tools output SCAD code — structured text, parseable but not schema-compliant. No formal change-log format across community tools.

headlines: Zoo.dev holds 90 and ships MCP v0.16.5 (Jun 12) — the most actively maintained agent surface in the probe with 51 releases; the only remaining ceiling is structured process-level DfM (5 → 15 gap)

Fusion AI holds 50 with MCP robustness improvements: auto-config now more reliable, multi-level help shipped — the barrier to first successful agent call dropped, though the display-bound geometry gate stays closed until Fusion Automation MCP exits private beta

MecAgent publishes its MCP thesis: 'proprietary macros over generic protocols' — a deliberate architectural bet that precision for SolidWorks/Inventor engineers matters more than open interoperability; the field is splitting between MCP-native and macro-native camps
